google.title: DaisyChess: Chess Analysis
google.shortDescription: Free chess analysis with Stockfish and Maia. Game review, puzzles. No ads.
google.fullDescription:
DaisyChess is a free chess analysis app. Load a game, let the engine review it, and see where it was decided: every move is rated, the best alternative is drawn on the board, and a graph shows how the evaluation moved.

No ads. No tracking. No subscription, no premium tier. DaisyChess is open source software (GPL-3.0-or-later) and the whole app is free for everyone.

GAME REVIEW
- Import a PGN, paste a position, or fetch your recent games from lichess or chess.com by username
- Every move is classified (best, good, inaccuracy, mistake, blunder) and the better move is shown as an arrow
- Accuracy for both sides, an evaluation graph and short explanations of the key moments
- Clock and time-trouble overview when the game has clocks
- Reviews are saved on your device, so a game opens instantly next time

STOCKFISH ON YOUR PHONE, OR ON A SERVER
- Stockfish runs directly in the app, with nothing to set up
- For deeper analysis, connect to a DaisyChess server or a community node: people who lend the engine of a spare computer to friends or to everyone. Server analysis may need an access token, which the node's owner gives you
- You choose where analysis runs, and you can see which engine did the work

PLAY AGAINST STOCKFISH OR MAIA
- Stockfish at adjustable strength
- Maia, a neural network trained on human games, plays the way players of a given rating really play (needs a server)
- Clocks, take-backs and a review of the finished game with one tap

PUZZLES
- About 300,000 curated puzzles from the lichess puzzle database (CC0), filtered by theme or opening, with a daily puzzle, a streak and timed Puzzle Rush
- A rating that follows your results; puzzles keep working offline once downloaded
- Your mistakes: puzzles made from the blunders in your own reviewed games, repeated with spaced repetition

OPENINGS
- Search about 3,900 named openings
- Openings trainer: drill a line with spaced repetition and play the position out against Maia or Stockfish
- Opening explorer with lichess database statistics (needs a free lichess login or token)

PLAY A FRIEND
- Start a game and share a link. Your friend opens it in the app or in the browser, no account needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no advertising or analytics SDKs, no account
- Your games and settings stay on your device. Positions are sent to a server only when you ask for server analysis or play on one
- Details: daisychess.org/privacy

BUILT ON OPEN SOURCE
DaisyChess builds on Stockfish, Leela Chess Zero, Maia and the lichess board. Read the code, run your own node, send a fix: daisychess.org

Publisher: INCEPTUM e.U., Vienna, Austria. Questions and feedback: hello@daisychess.org
